name: No Mercy From My Cowboy Daddy
original_name: No Mercy From My Cowboy Daddy
overview: Sydney flees to her boyfriend Billy's ranch after a fight with her father, only to discover Billy's betrayal. There, she becomes entangled with his enigmatic father, Ryder, a powerful businessman with secrets of his own. As Sydney navigates danger from a scheming rival and her manipulative father, she uncovers a hidden world of crime and deception. Amid mistrust and growing attraction, Ryder protects her, leading to truth, redemption, and an unexpected future together.
